candidates.statement: Order service connection pool exhaustion: order traces show postgres.acquire_connection errors (1350ms), order logs record 7 db_pool_acquire_timeout errors (503), and order metrics show db_pool_waiters=24 with p95 1100ms, propagating to gateway call-order errors.
candidates.uncertainty: Deployment record (3.1.3, 741min old) does not establish causation; gateway metrics show no local fault, consistent with downstream propagation.

report.explanation: Order service shows db pool acquire timeouts, 24 waiters, and elevated p95, with gateway call-order errors downstream. Evidence supports db-pool-exhaustion as the bounded root cause; deployment record alone cannot establish causation.
